status: Concrete production interface before JVM implementation; Swift owner integration assigned separately by root

sameResources.session: Existing RuntimeSession instance from parent login invocation
sameResources.sourceOwner: Existing session.options.stateOwner/binding, same source snapshot/revision; no new owner identifier or credential store
sameResources.http: Existing RuntimeSession.http and same App Cookie owner
sameResources.cache: Existing RuntimeSession.persistentCacheMemory/RuleCache backing, no new result-value store

sourceBrowserAddedFields.localPage: Optional {pageId,sessionId,parentTaskId,javaName,cacheName,resultName:String}; only trusted producer. Presence is Activity localHtml=true, independent of POST body overwrite.

webJsRequest.input: {pageId:String,method:String,params:[String?],timeoutMs:Int<=30000,function:String?,requestId:String?}; request accepts <=64 wire params and uses first6 per original Array(6); direct finite methods <=6.
webJsRequest.reply: {kind:string|stringList|void|callback,value:String?,values:[String]?,requestId:String?,success:Bool?}; callback carries no payload store of its own
webJsRequest.authority: pageId must exist in this same RuntimeSession and be live; source task provenance/owner are minted by existing producer, never imported script JSON
webJsRequest.asynchronousJavaRequest: method=request requires original function name and requestId. Execute on retained AnalyzeRule, place actual String result/error in the existing RuleCache memory, then return callback identity+success. Existing WK handler invokes the generated JSBridgeResult only after this operation completes. Generated JS_INJECTION2 callback synchronously obtains cache.getFromMemory(id), then cache.deleteMemory(id), then resolves/rejects and removes JS callback.
webJsRequest.directCacheCalls: Existing cache String/memory operations preserve nullable/void returns. cache.get(key,onlyDisk=false) forwards its actual Boolean to existing RuleCache.get(key,Boolean), distinguishing disk from a memory overlay; no silently ignored second argument.

webJsPageClose.reply: {closed:true}; stop admission, cancel all page child jobs, await drain, close AnalyzeRule/environment and remove same-session transient page entry

wire.callerAPI: Package calls same LegadoRuntime.execute(session:operation:) on existing regular worker; no MainJSSourceService acquire or old BookSourceSession/JSC handler
wire.sourceBrowserExistingBody: Existing prefetchedHTML is the sole optional final prepared body: GET explicitHTML is JS_INJECTION2-inserted (including explicit empty); POST override is actual prefetched body, including empty, with no reinjection. Await true reuses exactly this value. Raw explicitHTML never crosses Host wire, and no second ambiguous localHTML body field exists.

runtimeLifecycle.register: prepareLoginBrowser admits explicit localHTML under current task.sourceBrowserAllowed, records random pageId in same RuntimeSession transient page-scope map before Host dispatch
runtimeLifecycle.analysis: One retained page AnalyzeRule(source=same snapshot,nullBook,nullChapter); serialize requests with cancellable coroutine Mutex, enter original Rhino from child worker context only
runtimeLifecycle.taskRouting: Each page operation uses its normal current RuntimeTask/deadline/job. Retained page environment routes ProductionRulePlatform/persistence dispatch to the sole admitted current child task while page mutex is held; no use of the parent actively executing Rhino Context. Session HTTP/cache/persistence owner stay identical.
runtimeLifecycle.parentAwait: Parent remains blocked in source.browser. Page request executes under page lease on another existing JVM worker without reacquiring the parent source gate. Parent cancellation/deadline closes page and cancels/drains children.
runtimeLifecycle.parentNonawait: Host retains same original invocation session/source-binding lease before presented ACK. Parent normal completion releases producer reference only; actual page close drains children then permits existing Preview owner final close(session)/revoke(owner). Ordinary script error after an accepted nonawait presentation follows same accepted-page lifetime; explicit cancellation/source revision invalidation still closes.
runtimeLifecycle.sessionClose: Explicit close(session) seals/removes page entries and cancels child work before underlying session resources release. No page can survive an explicit session close or source invalidation.
runtimeLifecycle.perRequestTaskAdmission: Each admitted page operation is task.sensitiveSourceOperation=true for diagnostics but sourceBrowserAllowed=false; a page must not borrow parent login admission to create nested browser UI.

SwiftOwnerIntegration.LegadoPreviewStateOwner: Attach current runtime+session to its existing persistent source Binding before producer execution. Keep existing invocation resource lifetime until producer completed AND all accepted localPage leases ended; no replacement session/owner.
SwiftOwnerIntegration.LegadoPersistentStateHost: On localPage source.browser validate exact current binding/session/parent/page metadata, attach original page request/close closures. Each request validates current source revision and request-local deadline/cancellation using same Binding, then calls Package direct runtime operation.
SwiftOwnerIntegration.SourceBrowserPresenter: Existing ticket retains page lease and original-only run/cache/java callback; successful nonawait presentation retains it until actual close/drain. Use same UIKit/Cookie/seed lifecycle.
SwiftOwnerIntegration.JsBridgeBrowserView: Install correct JS_INJECTION2 run/java/cache surface with owned WK message/prompt tasks. Callback results resolve/reject once and consume/delete existing cache result ids; no old sourceRunHandler fallback. Keep challenge/confirm/DOM/cookie/dismiss terminal semantics.
SwiftOwnerIntegration.valueConversion: Use typed finite string/null/string-list/void result envelope; never coerce nullable result to empty String or expose raw live JVM object. Generated javaName/cacheName/resultName from localPage identify document-start native shim and JS_INJECTION2 callback; all are bounded ASCII identifiers.
SwiftOwnerIntegration.configuration: Activity upConfig callback=nil still dedups but does not resize a sheet; showBrowser remains separate.

ordering.GET: Prepare explicit HTML by locked head insertion before browser load, even empty input. Await true returns same prepared HTML, false returns actual DOM/URL.
ordering.POST: Original AnalyzeUrl prefetch once overrides prepared HTML while localHtml flag stays true; do not reinject replacement or duplicate POST.
ordering.cancellation: After prefetch and before native admission recheck; stop late initial loads, pending page requests and future publication; issued effects retained, no rollback claim.

completeInitialChain: Explicit HTML original preparation and actual page host registration
run Promise -> original AnalyzeRule java binding -> typed String result/error -> existing cache consume/delete
same owner cache basic String get/put/memory/delete
same page analysis mutable content/baseURL across requests
remainingTypedUnsupported: Unported WebView/file/download/crypto/extra inherited UI operations must reject by exact method; no helper-only success claim.
General showBrowser sheet/fullWebJS and verification-flight coalescing remain separate.

supersedes: interface-v3.json retained immutable; only explicit parameter limits/onlyDisk semantics clarified
oneBodyPriority: JVM private raw explicitHTML -> original head insertion/preparation -> POST replaces prepared body if applicable -> existing prefetchedHTML field; localPage flag remains present for both GET and POST.
